text:
sarah (AE): Heads up — SignalWorks pushed back on our redlines. Main asks: customer-managed KMS in the DPA, reduce SLA to 99.5% (they want that as committed), change indemnity cap to unlimited for IP claims, and they prefer Adobe Sign for e-sign. They also said procurement requires a PO (net45). Link to their redline: https://example.com/signalworks/redline.pdf

javier (AM): Thanks. Looping legal + se. Quick q: can we take 99.5 for enterprise? that's below our usual SLA. Also KMS for hosted is a hard no unless Private deployment.

raj (SE): For the POC we can be flexible on billing/payment terms (net45 ok), but KMS request will break prefix caching and affects latency/cost. We should push back or offer it only for dedicated/private. POC SOW + temporary orderform could work.

katie (Legal): Read through their edits. Customer-managed KMS: we cannot accept that for Hosted/Shared models. Proposed compromise: explicit KMS-only-for-Private clause; for Hosted, we offer an encryption-at-rest + BYOK for on-premides or VPC installs. SLA: we can agree to 99.5% for an initial 3-month ramp with a sunset back to 99.9% thereafter, and service credits capped to the monthly invoice. Indemnity: we will not accept unlimited IP indemnity. Counteroffer: indemnity limited to direct damages up to 1x annual fees, carve-outs for gross negligence.

lena (Security): Also need to complete their SIG questionnaire, confirm SOC 2 Type II, and provide a subprocessor list with attestations. For e-sign: Adobe Sign is fine, but procurement wants DocuSign for automated ingestion — ask SignalWorks which they prefer. If they insist on Adobe Sign, we'll need a manual contract upload workflow.

zach (Finance): We can accept PO net45 for the POC+pilot but require the PO to reference the orderform number and include billing contact + VAT info. For larger commitments (>100k ARR) we need payment on receipt or net30.

contracts-bot: New redline uploaded to internal CLM: https://redwood.internal/contracts/1777777777/signalworks-redline (preview available).

sarah (AE): Proposed next steps: 1) Legal to send a mark with (a) explicit KMS scope limiting to Private, (b) SLA ramp language (99.5% for 90 days then 99.9%), (c) indemnity cap at 1x fees, (d) DocuSign + Adobe Sign accepted but DocuSign preferred for integration. 2) SE to confirm technical impact of BYOK for private vs hosted. 3) Finance to confirm PO fields we need. 4) Ask SignalWorks for SIG + SOC2 report.

javier (AM): I'll message the buyer and say we're preparing a targeted counter; ask them which e-sign platform they'd prefer if we can support both but have a preferred flow.

katie (Legal): Draft snippet I'm going to propose (pasting redline):
```
Customer-managed keys: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Customer may only use Customer-managed keys for Private or on-prem deployments. For Hosted/Shared services, Redwood will provide encryption at rest and in transit; Customer-managed KMS is not supported.

Service Level: For the initial 90-day pilot term, Redwood will provide a service availability SLA of 99.5%. After the pilot term, SLA will revert to 99.9%. Service credits are the sole remedy and are capped at the fees for the affected month.

Indemnity cap: Except for claims arising from willful misconduct or gross negligence, the aggregate liability of Redwood shall not exceed the fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim.
```

lena (Security): That language looks good. Also add: "Redwood will supply SOC 2 Type II report and a list of subprocessors for the services used within 5 business days of countersignature."

zach (Finance): Confirming PO fields: orderform number, billing contact, remit address, VAT number (if EU), currency, total amount, and reference to SOW if applicable. We'll accept net45 for the pilot only.

sarah (AE): Great. I'll send that counter today and ask for an updated redline + preferred e-sign provider. Can someone own follow-ups?

katie (Legal): I'll own the counter and post it here when sent.

raj (SE): I'll call out the technical caveats to the buyer in the same thread (latency, cache invalidation with BYOK).

zach (Finance): I'll prep the PO template for net45 pilot and share doc to signalworks procurement.

sarah (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: — goal is to keep POC on track this week. If they accept the counter we can route for exec sign (CRO + SignalWorks CFO) and finance/process the PO.

contracts-bot: Reminder: If client signs in Adobe Sign, manual upload required for CLM. If DocuSign, auto-ingest will run.

sarah (AE): Noted. I'll nudge procurement to pick DocuSign if possible.

katie (Legal): Sent counter at 1777777800. Waiting on their redline.

sarah (AE): Received their reply — they accepted SLA ramp but asked again about KMS for hosted. Forwarding now.

raj (SE): I'll hop on a quick call with their infra lead to explain BYOK constraints.

sarah (AE): Update: SignalWorks procurement prefers Adobe Sign but can use DocuSign if we provide the integration instructions. They also attached the SIG-lite. Forwarding to security. End state: looks like we can close this week with the counter + PO. :party_parrot:
